golden_template.target: Learn Workspace + Practice Room + MCQ-only Core Readiness

production_rules: ChatGPT authors/integrates from reviewed KNTT maps + existing Practice manifests as source-of-truth.
Gemini is routed as pedagogical reviewer after a complete production draft exists, not as schema/source lead.
Every Core micro/readiness item has exactly one assessed skill; supporting skills do not receive automatic accuracy updates.
Existing skill IDs are reused whenever they match; new Core gaps require real Practice Bank coverage before rollout.
Layer-review skills are not promoted to Core without explicit source evidence.
No hard gate; Entrance10/Challenge never affect Core readiness.
acceptance: All three topics follow frozen Golden Template invariants.
Any new Core skill gap has actual interactive Practice Bank coverage.
Core Readiness remains MCQ-only and after-submit.
Forbidden/layer-review skills are excluded from Core until verified.
CI + strict MkDocs build + gh-pages smoke check pass.
